title: Automated DevSecOps Pipeline
objective: Integrate automated security checks into a demonstration software project.
skills: Controlled build permissions and artifact checks
scenario: You are preparing a learning artifact for a fictional organization. Use synthetic assets and data only; do not include real credentials, customer records, or unauthorized findings.

milestones.title: Milestone 1: Secret scanning
acceptance_criteria: Document the scope and expected outcome for secret scanning.
Provide sanitized, reproducible evidence and an appropriate defensive recommendation.

milestones.title: Milestone 2: Dependency analysis and static checks
acceptance_criteria: Document the scope and expected outcome for dependency analysis and static checks.
Provide sanitized, reproducible evidence and an appropriate defensive recommendation.

milestones.title: Milestone 3: Controlled build permissions and artifact checks
acceptance_criteria: Document the scope and expected outcome for controlled build permissions and artifact checks.
Provide sanitized, reproducible evidence and an appropriate defensive recommendation.

milestones.title: Milestone 4: Documented release gates
acceptance_criteria: Document the scope and expected outcome for documented release gates.
Provide sanitized, reproducible evidence and an appropriate defensive recommendation.

required_features: Controlled build permissions and artifact checks
stretch_features: Add a negative test or failure scenario
Add a safe verification and rollback plan
test_plan: Validate against a synthetic dataset or authorized isolated lab.
Include at least one expected-success and one expected-denial/failure case.
Record tool/runtime versions, sanitized outputs, and the criteria used to accept the result.
Verify every high-priority recommendation or clearly mark validation as pending.

rubric.criterion: Technical solution and detection or control quality
Governance, safe handling and final report

review_method: Human review supported by reproducible synthetic/lab evidence. No project is granted a security certification or executed in CodeLeaf production.
status_note: Draft project derived from Cybersecurity.pdf Section D. Use only a fictional organization and safe authorized artifacts.
